details.outcome: Reduce handling time while maintaining acceptable quality and sustainable costs

scope.proposed_scale: Five internal users reviewing synthetic batches

material_issue.summary: Unacceptable critical errors remain in the proposed workflow.
material_issue.next_step: Keep affected outputs out of use, resolve the failure and commission an acceptable retest.

business_outcome.note: Fictional BR-01 records measured savings above the agreed threshold, acceptable quality trade-offs and full operating costs within budget.

baseline.note: Fictional BL-02 records a comparable baseline on the same batches, population and measurement method with sampling limits documented.

representative_test.note: Fictional RT-03 covers intended users, routine and exceptional cases at the proposed scale on the current workflow and model version.

quality_review.note: Fictional QR-04 is complete, but records unresolved critical errors and rejects wider use.

workflow_owner.note: Fictional OW-05 records current role acceptance, stop authority, support budget and a tested continuity handover.

human_oversight.note: Fictional HO-06 records an effective timed human review exercise with escalation and prevention of routine approval bypass.

data_approval.note: Fictional DP-07 records current permission for the actual data, purpose, tool and recipients, with applicable security and contract checks accepted.

rollback.note: Fictional RC-08 records a proportionate safe-stop and manual recovery exercise, plus prevention and containment of irreversible external effects.

user_training.note: Fictional UR-09 records willing users successfully performing the workflow, with instructions, support and sustainable maintenance cover.

monitoring.note: Fictional MO-10 records owned alerts, a practised incident response, review dates and re-evaluation after material changes.
